Folded into elements[] with element_id/element_type, and mark->element_id, size_m -> width_mm/height_mm, thickness_m -> thickness_mm, rebar/top/bottom strings -> objects. Every original string is kept in a *_printed_as field. NOTE: the array named 'column_sections' actually held BEAM sections - every cut_ref names a B-mark - so those became element_type 'beam', with the cut label kept in section_ref. confidence_score is null because this house never recorded one; it was NOT invented.
